summary: Software engineer with 13+ years of building and owning production-critical e-commerce platforms end-to-end (Symfony, Sylius, Magento 2, Shopware 6): architecture, API and data modeling, 15 payment integrations, ERP/CRM synchronization, and GitOps delivery on Kubernetes with Argo CD. Delivers features spec-first with AI agents and reviews every plan, test and diff before it ships. Author of open-source plugins for JetBrains and Sylius and of an agentic SDLC pipeline for legacy codebases.

description: Own the architecture and delivery of the global e-commerce platform abrites.com end-to-end — 4 independent legal entities, per-client dynamic pricing, and 15 integrated payment providers, 8 of them implemented from scratch for specific regional requirements.

Integrated my open-source Claude Agentic SDLC pipeline into the Abrites codebases, both for the live platform and for new projects: each change gets a risk tier that sets its review, security and test gates, and guard hooks protect legacy behaviour.

Deliver features spec-first with AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Junie): nothing merges before I approve the plan, the tests and the diff, and recurring review corrections become agent instructions, skills and hooks.

Built a GitOps delivery platform on Kubernetes: one generic Helm chart for all projects, Argo CD syncing from a self-hosted GitLab with CI runners, pinned and compatibility-tested versions, and isolated runtimes for legacy applications.
Designed the data model, validation and normalization across heterogeneous external sources, resolving entity relationships between divergent ERP schemas without direct contextual links.
Built a modular design system from Figma: Sass design tokens, reference HTML and Stimulus controllers in TypeScript, covered by Vitest, Playwright and axe accessibility tests.

Maintain the internal ERP/CRM (Python/Django + PostgreSQL), a custom Symfony-based CMS, an event management system, a REST API (Django REST Framework + Swagger), GitLab CI pipelines, and a Dolibarr ERP integration.
Delivered large-scale Magento (Adobe Commerce) e-commerce projects in close partnership with the Dutch agency Diract.
Customized core functionality, built custom B2B modules and processes, and redesigned the checkout and invoicing pipeline.
Built the Docker-based CI/CD production flow: containerized environments, automated build and test pipelines, and deployments to Linode servers.
Developed and maintained projects across the full range of scale — from landing pages for local businesses to complex systems for banks and insurance companies.
Built custom e-commerce solutions from scratch.
Worked on a variety of small to mid-scale websites and APIs.

educationNote: Self-taught engineer — 13+ years of continuous hands-on learning in production systems, capped by published open-source work on the JetBrains Marketplace and the official Sylius Addons store.

personalProjects.note: Built with AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, JetBrains Junie), my own tooling and custom MCP commands.

items.name: Claude Agentic SDLC
items.description: Agentic delivery pipeline for Claude Code, built for legacy production codebases. Each change gets a risk tier (T0–T5) that sets its gates — planning, review, security and test agents, plus guard hooks against out-of-scope edits and pushes to protected branches — and ends at human approval.

items.name: Claude Subscription ACP Agent — JetBrains plugin
items.description: JetBrains Marketplace plugin that adds a Claude Subscription (Pro/Max) ACP agent to the AI Assistant chat agent picker — use a Claude subscription directly inside JetBrains IDEs.

items.name: Vanssa Sylius Slider
items.description: Feature-rich responsive slider plugin for Sylius 2, published on the official Sylius Addons store — translatable image and video slides, live admin previews, Symfony UX rendering, Twig Hooks, and optional CMS integrations. Tested with PHPUnit, Behat and Playwright; CI on GitHub Actions. Written entirely by AI agents through my agentic SDLC pipeline: I wrote the specs and reviewed every plan and diff.
